QuestInfo.name: A Shower of Gifts
QuestInfo.0: Enin is ecstatic to see Blake in person. She seems to be hesitating, though...
QuestInfo.1: Enin wants you to deliver her gifts and a letter to Blake for her. She's too embarrassed to do it herself. What a strange girl.
QuestInfo.2: Blake wants you to set the gifts aside, since he gets so many and can't keep track of them all. He sounds...kinda like a jerk.

0.0: Blake! You're so dreamyyyyy! You're just... so lovely in person. Ah, I'm about to faint...finally, my life is complete!
0.1: B-but I suddenly feel so embarrassed. How am I supposed to get these gifts to him? Sigh... #h0#, do you know what it feels like to be a devoted fan? I don't want to ruin the moment...please help me!

yes.0: Thank you. I...hope Blake likes the gifts.

1.0: What is it? Are you the manager around here? If so, talk to Lana. I'm busy.
1.1: What, a gift? Eh, just put it aside over here. I get tons of the things, so many that I don't have time to open 'em all. My manger will check 'em out later.

yes.0: This is a pain. Definitely not doing signings in a dump like this again.

item.0: I must get these gifts to Blake...Could you do that for me?
